caption: The drawing features a rectangular pattern with a deep blue background and irregular, organic shapes resembling clusters of brownish and reddish forms spread throughout the space. These shapes are outlined and accented with a vivid orange-red border and are interwoven with green oval elements that resemble leaves. There are small pink and white circular details scattered among the brownish forms, giving the appearance of blossoms or fruit. The entire composition is centered on a plain, cream-colored background. Handwritten text appears at the lower right corner, reading "AVPS 5. FLORENCE STEVENSON."
title: Glazed Chintz
